語意解析 這是一個智慧財產的黃金時代(鼎盛時期)。過去從沒有過這麼多以
專利技術創立公司。專利申請和核發暴增，多到有專利「革命」的說法。根

questions.stem: This is a "golden age" of IP, or Intellectual Property. Never before have so many companies been built around patented technology. Patent filings and issuance are skyrocketing, so much so that there is talk of a patent "revolution." Everything under the sun made by man is patentable according to the spirit of the copyright and patent laws. Formerly unpatentable business methods and computer algorithms are also patentable now. What does IP stand for?
